exposure: Gestational age at delivery (34 weeks, 35 weeks, 36 weeks and beyond)
Risk for unscheduled delivery (low vs. high)
outcome: Rates of unscheduled and emergent delivery
cohort: 84 patients with previa and suspected accreta who reached 34.0 weeks' gestational age
finding: Patients with suspected previa-accreta and no risk factors for preterm birth have a low risk of unscheduled delivery before 36 weeks.
